title: Schema fields, extracted (bootstrap-tools)
description: Candidate terms extracted from every schema field with a doc comment: `<Declaration>.<field>` as the label, the comment's first paragraph as the definition. Generated by folio-assistant-core/scripts/glossary-extract.ts; not curated, and never hand-edited: a person promotes a term by authoring it in a glossary of their own.

terms.definition: Must equal the path the document is published at (bootstrap-graph-publication).
The instance-bound collectors that were NOT run. "Has no tools" and "tools were never looked for" are different facts; this is how the document says which one it means.
